name: Helga the Viking Warrior 6: Beyond Ragnarok
storyline:
The world has changed forever. Ragnarok has come and gone, leaving destruction in its wake. The mighty gods have fallen, and the once-powerful Nine Realms now lie in ruin, scattered remnants of a lost age. Amidst the devastation, one warrior rises - Helga, the last survivor of an era long past. She awakens in a world without prophecy, where even the divine voices have gone silent. But beyond the broken gates of Asgard, an ancient presence watches, waiting for the new age to take shape.

Summoned by echoes of divine will, Helga embarks on her most perilous quest yet - to uncover the truth of what survived beyond Ragnarok. As she hunts for the lost artifacts of the old order, she slowly realizes that something else was born in the void. Something beyond gods and monsters. Something that was never meant to exist.
summary: Embark on an epic journey through the ruins of the Nine Realms. Engage in match-3 battles infused with post-Ragnarok magic and cosmic distortions.
